Definition: Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehizkiah the son of Shallum was one of the heads of Ephraim who stood up against those who came from the war, when the men of Israel brought back captives from Judah. He and his fellows refused to keep the spoil and sent the captives home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the men who stood against the spoil were right, and Jehizkiah's stand is the mercy of God in the midst of war.
